summary:
iter247 — Phase 2 VPS Agent Service: (1) Agent-Enrol one-liner on InfraWizard Path B, and (2) RESTART TERMINAL button + POST /vps/agents/{agent_id}/restart-terminal — all green on both backend and frontend.

BACKEND (5/5 pass, /app/test_reports/iter247_vps_live_test.py against the preview backend):
  1. POST /api/infra/vps/connect-existing as admin returns deployment_id + enrollment_code 'EJP-526' (format [A-Z]{3}-\d{3}), vps_agent_sha256 = 64-hex, and vps_agent_command containing '/api/setup/agent.ps1', 'Install-StoicAgent -ServerUrl', the UPPERCASED sha256 pin, and `-EnrollmentCode "<code>"`. Verified the body SHA-256 of GET /api/setup/agent.ps1 exactly equals vps_agent_sha256 (hash-pin is honest).
  2. POST /api/vps/agents/.../restart-terminal unauthenticated → 401 (auth cookie not accepted).
  3. Admin POST .../restart-terminal with an unknown agent_id → 404 vps_restart_refused.
  4. Admin POST .../restart-terminal for a FRESHLY SEEDED online agent (vps_agents doc inserted directly: user_id=admin, agent_token_hash=sha256(tok), command_seq=0, last_heartbeat=now, deployment_id='dep_test', no mtls doc so the mtls gate is skipped) WITHOUT an mt5_instances doc → 409 vps_restart_refused (static_error maps the ValueError('no agent-managed terminal — install it on the VPS first') to a canned client-safe message; original phrasing is in server logs only — behaviour correct).
  5. After POST /api/vps/agent/terminals/report {agent_token, login, account_id, status:'running'} creates the mt5_instances doc, POST .../restart-terminal → 200 {ok:true, command_id:'cmd_...', agent_id, login}; the queued 'restart_terminal' command is then visible via POST /api/infra/agent/commands/poll {agent_token} with params.login == admin account's account_number.
  Cleanup: fixture teardown deletes the inserted vps_agents, mt5_instances and agent_commands for the test agent and $unset-s accounts.vps_terminal on the pinned account — nothing left behind.

FRONTEND (both features pass against https://stoic-trading-bot.preview.emergentagent.com):
  Feature 1 — /infrastructure → ADD TRADING VPS → path 'existing_vps' → GENERATE INSTALL COMMAND → data-testid='vps-agent-enrol' renders; data-testid='enrollment-code' shows EJP-526; data-testid='vps-agent-enrol-command' contains 'Install-StoicAgent', the enrollment code and '/api/setup/agent.ps1'; data-testid='vps-agent-enrol-copy' flips COPY → COPIED on click (clipboard write succeeded with granted perms).
  Feature 2 — Accounts page: with a seeded running VPS terminal mirrored onto the account (via /api/vps/agent/terminals/report), InstallProgressPanel renders data-testid='install-vps-terminal-<accountId>' with data-status='running' and label 'VPS agent terminal: RUNNING — iter247 UI fixture'; the data-testid='install-vps-restart-<accountId>' button is present; clicking it fires POST /api/vps/agents/.../restart-terminal and surfaces the success toast 'Restart queued (cmd_2cf3d1eaea) — the agent closes MT5 gracefully and starts it again'. Teardown ran via the helper script.

No backend or frontend issues. Code review nits only (below).
critical_code_review_comments: vps_pathb.vps_agent_enrol_command() pins SHA-256 against the exact bytes served by GET /api/setup/agent.ps1 (verified empirically — body sha256 == advertised sha256). The one-liner is tamper-evident: a MITM swap of the script body changes the hash and the agent install throws 'STOIC agent script hash mismatch'.

vps_terminals.queue_restart_terminal correctly refuses when no mt5_instances doc exists for (agent_id, login), with the message 'no agent-managed terminal for this account — install it on the VPS first' — maps to 409 vps_restart_refused via vps_terminal_routes.restart_terminal's ValueError handler. The static_error wrapper surfaces only the canned message to the client (good: no internal state leak), the original is logged. If the product wants the specific phrasing on the UI toast, the route should pass the ValueError message through — currently the user sees the generic 'conflict — the operation is not allowed in the current state'. Non-blocking.

InstallProgressPanel.jsx guards the RESTART TERMINAL button with !['queued','installing'].includes(status) — correct, matches queue_restart_terminal's requirement that the terminal exists / is beyond installing. Toast on success uses data.command_id which is returned by the endpoint — integration verified.
vps_terminal_routes._agent re-imports routes.infra_routes._mtls_gate inside the request path (unchanged since iter246) — fine functionally, module-level import would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both features verified end-to-end in the preview UI)

test_credentials: admin@trading.bot — password from backend/.env TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD (unquoted); fallback to /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No credential embedded in any test file.
seed_data_creation: Backend fixture inserts a vps_agents doc (agent_id prefix 'agt_iter247_'), one agent_commands row via restart-terminal, and one mt5_instances row via /vps/agent/terminals/report; all removed on teardown. UI test uses iter247_ui_setup.py --setup/--teardown which mirrors the same pattern on a separate 'agt_iter247ui_' agent — teardown invoked and verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live suite: `cd /app && DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot STOIC_TESTS_ALLOW_DB_NAME=1 python -m pytest test_reports/iter247_vps_live_test.py -v`. The fixture seeds data directly on MongoDB (bypasses mTLS by not setting agent.mtls) and uses /api/vps/agent/terminals/report to create the mt5_instances row — a legitimate agent API call that goes through _mtls_gate (which short-circuits for agents without an enrolled cert). To exercise the UI, iter247_ui_setup.py --setup seeds, prints ACCOUNT_ID/AGENT_ID; --teardown cleans up. The admin account used was the first live (mode!='paper') admin account with an account_number. Preview backend uses MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot.
